messages.subject_clean: 使用ggplot2畫qqplot
messages.body_plain:
Hi IY,

參考使用 ggplot  + stat_qq() + facet_wrap( ~ groups, ncol=4), 其中stat_qq 繪製qq圖,  facet_wrap 一張圖形分成4欄繪圖.

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-m3tKIQ_T6cg/WY1Ke4sJqjI/AAAAAAAAL2k/VP3Xit_puA8RPV0AKgnazWd4SksXCCxuQCLcBGAs/s1600/%25E5%25AE%25A2%25E8%25A3%25BD%25E5%258C%2596qqplot.png>

# title: 客製化qqplot
# date: 2017.8.11

library(ggplot2)

length.x <- 10
length.y <- 100
length.z <- 1000

x1 <- rnorm(length.x)
x2 <- rnorm(length.x)
x3 <- rnorm(length.x)
x4 <- rnorm(length.x)
y1 <- rnorm(length.y)
y2 <- rnorm(length.y)
y3 <- rnorm(length.y)
y4 <- rnorm(length.y)
z1 <- rnorm(length.z)
z2 <- rnorm(length.z)
z3 <- rnorm(length.z)
z4 <- rnorm(length.z)

mydf <- data.frame(groups=c(paste0("x", gl(4, length.x)),
                            paste0("y", gl(4, length.y)),
                            paste0("z", gl(4, length.z))),
                   measures=c(x1,x2,x3,x4,y1,y2,y3,y4,z1,z2,z3,z4))

ggplot(mydf, aes(sample=measures)) +
  stat_qq() +
  facet_wrap( ~ groups, ncol=4) +
  ggtitle("QQ圖") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) + # 標題置中
  xlab("理論值") +
  ylab("觀測值")
# end

Hi Guke,

參考以下內容:

1. biosignalEMG套件可應用於EMG分析, 內容包括積分之計算.
https://cran.r-project.org/package=biosignalEMG

2. R內建 integrate 函數可用於積分計算.

3. 如果須撰寫程式進行積分計算, 可採用以下方法:

數值積分-梯形法則
數值積分-辛浦森法則
http://web.ydu.edu.tw/~alan9956/docu3/0991cal/calculus_ch07.pdf

4. Excel 梯形法則-範例參考:
http://www.myengineeringworld.net/2013/06/integration-in-excel-trapezoidal-rule.html

5. 執行參考結果

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-Tg3HiMTZMAg/WZW6mwO_fSI/AAAAAAAAL3g/RLEd-fMsFT8trXQ-h2lVtoP0h5DZBrUjwCLcBGAs/s1600/biosignalEMG.png>

6. R code

# title: 肌電信號EMG
# date: 2017.8.17

library(biosignalEMG)

integrate(dnorm, -1.96, 1.96) # 0.9500042
integrate(dnorm, -Inf, Inf) # 1

x <- read.table("emgsignal.csv", header=TRUE, sep=",")
str(x)
op <- par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

# plot1
plot(x$Ch1, type="l", main="graphics package")

# plot2
emg <- as.emg(x$Ch1, samplingrate=1000, units="mV") # need to verify?
plot(emg, main="biosignalEMG package")

# plot3
emgr <- rectification(emg, rtype = "fullwave")
emgi <- integration(emgr, reset = FALSE)
plot(emgi, main = "Integrated EMG (no reset)")

# plot4
emgma <- envelope(emgr, method = "MA", wsize = 60)
plot(emg, main = "MA-envelope")
plot(emgma, add = TRUE, lwd = 4, col = "red")

par(op)

?integration # integration of an EMG
# end

messages.subject: Re: R 使用 apply 家族函數 ?
messages.subject_clean: R 使用 apply 家族函數 ?
messages.body_plain:
Hi Kao,

1. 本例應該可以不用apply 即採用方法1直接計算結果.

2. 方法2使用 apply 函數, 因輸入參數為 a, b 二行, 因此輸入資料是 data1[,1:2], 第2個參數是1, 表示列, 第3個參數是 function(x) , 因輸入資料第1,2個元素分別表示 a,b, 因此使用指標 TWDtoF(x[1], x[2]).

3. apply 結果為 list, 使用 unlist 可轉換為向量(vector), 轉換為向量目的是將資料以列方式填滿至matrix, 再轉換為data.frame

4. matrix() 配合 byrow = TRUE 可將資料以列的方式填滿至矩陣, 否則以行方式填滿資料會異常.

5. as.data.frame 可將矩陣轉換為 資料框(data.frame).

6. 最後用 cbind函數將原資料與計算結果用欄方式結合.

7. identical(data2.a, data2.b) 顯示二種方法結果相同.

建議採用方法1較佳, 當然方法2亦可做為apply練習用.

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-CipUzHZzJvU/WZbqK1ba1LI/AAAAAAAAL38/AWILsV_-FusGfJYBgahXDD-9-euzcHmRwCLcBGAs/s1600/%25E5%25BB%25BA%25E7%25AB%258B%25E6%2596%25B0%25E6%25AC%2584%25E4%25BD%258Dapply%25E5%2587%25BD%25E6%2595%25B8.png>

# title: 建立新欄位apply函數
# date: 2017.8.18

# 原資料會導致根號內為負數,已調整資料集 a >= b
data1 <- data.frame(a=c(20,10,30), b=c(10,5,20), c=c(30,40,30))
data1
TWDtoF <- function(a = 6370, b = 5000) {

  e = (1 - b^2 / a^2)^0.5
  la = a + (b*e)
  lb = b + e

  ans = list(la, lb)
  return(ans)
}

# 方法1
data2.a <- data1
data2.a$la <- data1$a + data1$b*((1-(data1$b)^2/(data1$a)^2)^0.5)
data2.a$lb <- data1$b + (1-(data1$b)^2/(data1$a)^2)^0.5
data2.a

# 方法2
TWDtoF.ans <- unlist(apply(data1[,1:2], 1, function(x) TWDtoF(x[1], x[2])))
TWDtoFans.df <- as.data.frame(matrix(TWDtoF.ans, byrow = TRUE, ncol=2))
names(TWDtoFans.df) <- c("la", "lb")
data2.b <- cbind(data1, TWDtoFans.df)
data2.b

identical(data2.a, data2.b)
# end

messages.body_plain:
加载ggmap包后，执行
library(ggmap)
ggimage(hadley)
会出现一张hadley圖像 <https://pan.baidu.com/s/1jIopzDk>，这张图像尝试自己做一下，但是尝试了很多再次都失败了。原圖在這里 <https://pan.baidu.com/s/1eSoxARS>
程式如下：
library(EBImage)
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape)
image <- readImage('Hadley.jpg')
theme_set(theme_bw())
gimage <- function(image){
  require(ggplot2)
  # remove first pound for the image in the case study
  if(length(dim(image)) == 2){
    message('creating black and white image...')
    image <- melt(image)
    names(image) <- c('row','column','fill')
    plot <- qplot(column, -row, data = image, geom = 'tile', fill = fill) +
      scale_fill_gradient(low = 'black', high = 'white')
  }
 if(length(dim(image)) == 3){
   message('creating color image...')
   image <- apply(image,1:2,function(v)rgb(v[1],v[2],v[3]))
   image <- melt(image)
   plot <- ggplot(image, aes(row, -column, fill=fill)) + geom_tile() + scale_fill_identity()
 }
  plot +
    theme(
      axis.line = element_line(), axis.ticks = element_line(),
      axis.text.x = element_text(), axis.text.y = element_text(),
      axis.title.x = element_text(), axis.title.y = element_text(),
      axis.ticks.length = unit(0, "lines"),
      axis.ticks.margin = unit(0, "lines"),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.background = element_rect(),
      panel.border = element_rect(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(),
      panel.grid.minor = element_line(),
      panel.margin = unit(0, "lines"),
      plot.background = element_rect(),
      plot.title = element_text(),
      plot.margin = unit(c(-1, -1, -1.5, -1.5), "lines")
    )
}
gimage(image)

出現錯誤：Don't know how to automatically pick scale for object of type function. Defaulting to continuous.
               Error in FUN(X[], ...) : object 'column' not found.
請教該怎麼修正，多謝啦。
